tagline: Embodied Spatial Intelligence for Autonomous Industrial Assembly
primary_audience: Advanced manufacturing partners, robotics engineers, and deep-tech seed/Series-A investors

aesthetic_direction.typography: Chunky neo-grotesque header (e.g. Uncut Sans or Space Grotesk) with crisp utilitarian monospace technical callouts (e.g. JetBrains Mono)
aesthetic_direction.composition: High-contrast dark aesthetic, video loop of robotic micro-assembly dexterity, hardware exploded view interactive components, and investor deck download gate

media_guidelines: Real physical robot hardware prototypes, telemetry charts, high-frame-rate tactile manipulation video clips. Absolutely no generic AI generated plastic cyber-humans.
anti_patterns: Generic humanoid stock 3D renders with glowing blue brains
Vague claims with zero torque/tolerance engineering specs
Unstyled forms with standard browser controls
